name: Runemaster Mind Wrath makes Ley Lock interrupt 2 additional enemies near the target (#1248)
contract: Mind Wrath 800757 (Class tab, CharacterAdvancement 6477) reads 'Your Ley Lock now interrupts 2 additional
enemies near your primary target.' Its single effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 17
(SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS), BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3, class mask word 2 0x80000, which in SpellFamilyName 38
is only Ley Lock 800995 (SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, EffectChainTarget 0, DmgClass
magic, 500 ms cast, 2.5 sec school lockout). Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets applies the caster's
SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to the chain count, 0 + 3 = 3 targets, and SearchChainTargets picks the 2 closest other
enemies within 10 yards of the primary target (magic chains are not limited to the caster's front). No script is
needed; the report's premise (no handler) is wrong. Expected: three hostile players casting Conjure Water 5504
(3 sec, PreventionType silence, InterruptFlags 0xF, creates Conjured Water 5350) at the Runemaster's position:
without Mind Wrath a Ley Lock on one of them interrupts only that one and the other two conjure their water;
with Mind Wrath the same Ley Lock interrupts all three and nobody conjures anything.
